poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE SHADOWS OF YOUR DRAMA ARE FINALLY OVER.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: IT IS NOT PERSONAL; IT IS ONLY THE WAY THINGS GO.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS WAS NEVER ABOUT US OR OUR MEMORIES.
sonnetLines: The curtain falls on whispered pleas,
A fragile echo in the hall.
We built our moments, soft with ease,
Now watch the painted plaster fall.
No tears for what was ever planned,
Just dust upon a gilded floor.
You hold the script within your hand,
And close the heavy, bolted door.
The promise fades like morning mist,
A brittle sweetness in the air.
By selfish drama you were kissed,
Then left to face what isn't there.
It simply drifts away with time,
